required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.value: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:109.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/117.0

tools.name: match_detail
tools.description: Match general info, score, and basic data. FlashScore delimiter format. Required: matchId.

tools.name: match_events
tools.description: Match events: goals, cards, substitutions. FlashScore delimiter format. Required: matchId.

tools.name: match_h2h
tools.description: Head-to-head history between the two teams. FlashScore delimiter format. Required: matchId.

tools.name: match_lineups
tools.description: Team lineups and formations. FlashScore delimiter format. Required: matchId.

tools.name: match_stats
tools.description: Match statistics: possession, shots, corners, xG. FlashScore delimiter format. Required: matchId.

tools.name: matches_live
tools.description: Fetch Italian football matches currently in progress. No parameters required. Returns only live matches from today's feed, filtered by active status, in FlashScore delimiter format with current scores and match IDs. Prefer this over matches_today when you need only in-play matches to minimise noise.

tools.name: matches_today
tools.description: Fetch all Italian football matches for today. No parameters required. Returns the full day's schedule and live results in FlashScore delimiter format including team names, match IDs, kick-off times, and current scores. Use this as the primary entry point for today's fixtures; use matches_live to filter to only in-progress matches.

tools.name: matches_tomorrow
tools.description: Fetch Italian football fixtures scheduled for tomorrow. No parameters required. Returns a list of matches in FlashScore delimiter format including team names, kick-off times, and match IDs. Use this to retrieve the next day's schedule for planning pre-match analysis or odds queries.

tools.name: matches_yesterday
tools.description: Fetch Italian football results from yesterday. No parameters required. Returns completed matches in FlashScore delimiter format with final scores, team names, and match IDs. Use this when you need recent results for form analysis or H2H lookups without running a full sync.

tools.name: odds_match_odds
tools.description: Betting odds for a match: 1X2, Under/Over, Asian handicap. Required: eventId. Optional: projectId (default: 2), geoIpCode (default: IT).

tools.name: sports_all_today
tools.description: All sports today: calcio, tennis, basket, hockey, etc. FlashScore delimiter format.

tools.name: standings_table
tools.description: League table for a tournament. FlashScore delimiter format. Required: tournamentId, season (default: 2024), page (default: 3), locale (default: it).

params.name: tournamentId
params.description: Tournament ID (e.g. naYhNOaA for Serie A)
